component: Ord. 171879: Chapter 33.205 Accessory Rental Units rewritten as Accessory Dwelling Units; ADUs added to a house in residential zones citywide, including detached ADUs, ending the rule that limited them to internal conversions of large, older, owner-occupied homes
coverage: City of Portland: houses in R (single- and multi-dwelling), C and EX zones
source_section: Ord. No. 171879 (substitute), findings 3 and 19, directive g, passed DEC 17 1997 (record pp. 12-20); PC Recommendation Sept 26, 1997 pp. 23-25
source_quote: In order to allow time for staff training and effective imlementation of code changes, this ordinance shall be in full force and effect on February 2, 1998.
coding_notes: Corrected by Ben's ordinance-validation agent (2026-11-04), partly verified: Portland's Accessory Structures Zoning Code Update adopted report (https://www.portland.gov/sites/default/files/2020-02/accessory_structures_adopted_report.pdf, regulatory history pp. 95-96: 'Owner occupancy provisions dropped.') says the 1997/98 expansion took effect in February 1998, dropped owner occupancy (owner_occ False from 1998, not 2016/2017/2020 as secondary sources had it), capped ADUs at 33% of the primary dwelling up to 800 sq ft (adu_max_sqft 800; the 33% is not a field), and allowed ADUs as an addition or a detached structure. The earlier Albina overlay rules had no size cap and no ADU parking requirement, so parking is left blank (not coded as a citywide parking removal). That report is a city primary document, not the ordinance or code text. Ordinance number, adoption date (1997-12-17) and effective day (1998-02-02) come from the first coder's reading of the Ord. 171879 record (source_url), which the validation agent could not load: the month is confirmed, the day is not. Findings say that from 1981 ADUs were limited to 'internal conversion of living space within large, older, owner-occupied homes'. Quote keeps the original typo 'imlementation'. Later amendments to 33.205 (2001-2016) not read. Before the state rows OR-4159000-adu-2018/2020; no end_date set.
